result.description: Website builder and ecommerce platform; developer APIs cover commerce data (orders, products, inventory, contacts, discounts, transactions) and webhooks.
result.auth_detail: Site-level API key (Bearer) generated in the merchant's site settings, for custom apps on one site; OAuth 2.0 (auth-code, scoped) for multi-merchant apps, requires registering the OAuth client and getting it reviewed/approved.
result.access_detail: API keys need the merchant's Commerce Advanced plan (paid). OAuth for third-party apps needs the OAuth client registered and reviewed/approved by Squarespace (approves OAuth connections only; Extensions listing is separate). Webhook Subscriptions API is OAuth-only. Plan requirement for OAuth is not stated on the OAuth page.
result.api_notes: REST at api.squarespace.com. Commerce APIs: Orders, Products, Inventory, Transactions, Contacts, Discounts, Profiles (maintenance; use Contacts), Forms (Zapier only), Webhook Subscriptions, plus Analytics/Websites and Reseller APIs. Create Order limited to 100 req/hour per site with API key.
result.blocker: Third-party OAuth needs Squarespace review/approval of the OAuth client; API-key route needs the paid Commerce Advanced plan per site. API is commerce-focused, not site-content editing.

evidence.quote: Depending on your development needs, authenticate requests by using an API key or OAuth access token.
With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
This review only approves your client for OAuth connections with Squarespace.
Read and write orders, products, inventory, and transactions
The Squarespace MCP server connects AI assistants to Squarespace.
The Commerce tools read and change a website, so they need you to sign in with your Squarespace account.
